noble_toolchain_used: lean 4.31.0 (nix store noble-lean-release-4.31.0), library rebuilt with its lean-toolchain overridden to v4.31.0

decision_basis.compatibility: the library builds under Noble's pinned Lean 4.31.0, but the upstream axiom-dependency receipts cannot be reused there
decision_basis.performance: see benchmark.out: build-inclusive index cost is 3.4x-20x the list cost at sizes 1-512, and repeated first-slot lookup is 1.5-2.5x slower while last-slot and absent lookups become far faster only from about 64 entries
